title: OpenViking: Free AI Agent Memory Database (Open Source)
description:
OpenViking is a free open-source context database that gives AI agents long-term memory across conversations, files, and skills. It cuts token costs by up to 91% and is a self-hosted alternative to Pinecone. Install with pip and use with Claude Code, OpenClaw, and more.
